title: Postman local data
whyItMatters: Postman keeps local collections, environments and request history here. Environment variables often contain API keys and access tokens, and the history shows every endpoint the person called.
source: Postman Support, How to remove local data: the Postman folders are under AppData/Roaming and AppData/Local on Windows - https://support.postman.com/hc/en-us/articles/4410785125271-How-to-remove-local-data
notes: Roaming holds collections, environments and history; Local holds the app install and cache and is covered by uninstalling. Postman Enterprise uses a separate PostmanEnterprise folder. Contents are not read.

cleanup.exportFirst: Export the collections and environments you need from Postman, and keep any API keys from environment variables somewhere safe.
cleanup.signOut: Sign out of Postman in the app, then remove this device from the account's sessions on the Postman website.
steps: Export the collections and environments you want to keep.
Sign out of Postman and close the app.
Uninstall Postman from Settings > Apps > Installed apps.
Delete the folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes local collections, environments, request history and the sign-in state from this PC. Anything already synced stays in the Postman account.
cleanup.source: Postman Support, How to remove local data: https://support.postman.com/hc/en-us/articles/4410785125271-How-to-remove-local-data
